headline: South Africa Explores Easing Exchange Controls to Build Financial Hub
summary: National Treasury and the South African Reserve Bank are considering relaxing exchange control restrictions to support the transformation of South Africa into an international financial centre.
why: Exchange controls limit capital flows into and out of South Africa; easing them would encourage foreign institutional investment into Johannesburg financial markets.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Deregulating exchange controls attracts cross-border institutional capital and enhances financial sector liquidity.
